verdict.rationale: The Hoppscotch CLI is documented as able to run API tests and 'automate monitoring' / 'manage automated API monitoring' from a terminal or automated system. `hopp test` can emit JUnit reports for collection runs, so failures could feed a CI pipeline. However, nothing in the evidence shows built-in scheduled monitors or alerting; scheduling and notifications would have to come from external cron or CI tooling. Missing for 10: native scheduled monitor feature, built-in alerting/notifications on failure, monitoring dashboard or history, independent corroboration.
